name: Prismskin Reactive Geneware Night Drape
description: A Tier 3 mid-level night-out statement built around geneware visibility — specifically designed for wearers with tails, bioluminescent skin patches, or decorative horns, presenting those modifications as the primary aesthetic focus rather than accommodating them as afterthoughts. The main garment is a floor-length open drape in reactive holographic mesh — a sheer, weightless fabric that shifts between deep violet, mirror-silver, and warm rose-gold depending on angle and ambient light, with embedded micro-LEDs threaded through every third strand that respond to the wearer's own bioluminescent output frequency. Where the wearer glows, the fabric amplifies. The drape falls open at the front, worn over a fitted bodysuit in matte black adaptive stretch — seamless, with a reinforced tail-port opening at the lower back finished in chrome grommet trim, and horn-clearance collar cut wide and low to frame rather than constrain. Beneath the drape, the bodysuit is close enough to read every line of chrome or scale underneath. Strappy sandals in translucent synth-resin with embedded amber light strips complete the foot. A single wide cuff in reactive holographic mesh worn at one wrist ties the drape to the body with an anchor point. The total effect in a dark club is something between a walking aurora and a controlled detonation.
functionality: Bioluminescent response mesh amplifies and echoes the wearer's own light output. Tail-port opening at lower back with chrome grommet finish accommodates all standard geneware tail configurations. Wide horn-clearance collar accommodates standard to large decorative horn sets. Adaptive stretch bodysuit conforms to non-standard body proportions including synthetic builds. Drape is detachable at wrist cuff anchor for quick removal.
what_it_says: You paid for your geneware and you want every person in this room to understand exactly what it cost — not in credits, in commitment. You are not hiding anything. The light is the point.
worn_by: mid-level professionals who save for weekend transformation
synthetic individuals with aesthetic light augmentation
manufacturer: Prismweave Studio — Tier 3 independent atelier, small-batch production, takes custom geneware measurements
story_hooks: The micro-LED frequency response in this drape is supposed to sync only to the wearer's own bioluminescent signature — but in the club, it begins resonating with someone else across the room, someone the wearer has never met, whose biolum signature should be genetically unique.

A Prismweave Studio piece is identified by a Tier 5 lawyer as part of an estate dispute — the reactive mesh design was allegedly based on stolen proprietary fabric patents, and every person wearing one may be implicated as unwitting evidence.

The wearer is approached by a the Gray Zone runner who claims the chrome grommet trim on their tail-port opening contains a hidden data cache — pressed there by a Prismweave employee who needed a dead drop and had access to the production line.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking floor-length silhouette that celebrates rather than conceals geneware modifications. The open holographic drape creates a dramatic, flowing frame around the fitted bodysuit beneath, with the wearer's bioluminescent features as the focal point. The overall impression is luminous and intentional—high-fashion statement wear designed for visibility in low-light environments.
physical_description.fit: The matte black bodysuit is seamless and form-fitting, sitting close to the skin to showcase chrome, scales, or other subcutaneous augmentations. The drape itself is loose and flowing, unrestricted—designed to move with the wearer rather than constrain. The collar is deliberately wide and low to fully frame neck, shoulders, and any horn modifications.
physical_description.primary_material: Holographic mesh (sheer, weightless, micro-LED embedded threads) for the drape and wrist cuff; adaptive stretch synth-knit for the bodysuit; translucent synth-resin for sandals with amber light strips
physical_description.texture: The holographic mesh has a gossamer, almost liquid quality—smooth to touch but visually complex, with a subtle iridescence. The bodysuit is matte and smooth, providing stark contrast. Chrome grommet trim at the tail-port adds tactile precision.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: deep violet, mirror-silver, and warm rose-gold (holographic, angle-dependent). Secondary: matte black (bodysuit). Accent: chrome grommets and amber light strips in footwear. Responsive glow from embedded micro-LEDs mirrors the wearer's bioluminescence.
physical_description.closures: The wrist cuff anchors the drape to the body via friction-fit and the garment's own design; the drape itself is open and unrestricted. The bodysuit appears seamless with no visible closures—likely friction-fit or subcutaneous anchor points.
distinctive_features: Reactive micro-LED threading that amplifies the wearer's bioluminescent output
Wide, low collar specifically designed to frame horn clearance and neck modifications
Holographic mesh that shifts color with viewing angle
Asymmetrical single wrist cuff that anchors the drape
Translucent synth-resin sandals with embedded amber light strips
Seamless, form-revealing bodysuit designed to showcase augmentations
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional luxury—bespoke, small-batch production from an independent atelier. Not mass-market, but accessible to working-class individuals with disposable income for statement wear.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by those who are proud of their geneware modifications and use fashion as a platform for celebrating them. Signals club culture, body modification enthusiasm, independent fashion sensibility, and comfort with one's augmented identity. Popular in GLMZ nightlife and performance spaces.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; quickly develops a lived-in patina from club environments—minor scuffs on the resin sandals, slight clouding of the holographic mesh from body oils and light exposure, though the LEDs remain bright and responsive. Well-maintained examples retain their luminosity for years.
